canonicalReview.reconciliationSummary: Canonical review uses the single reviewer result from epic-reviewer-1.
crossStoryFindings: Story 2's automatic live-capture bootstrap and Story 5's attach/import flow conflict in the production extension seam: `session_start` creates a managed thread before `/lh-attach` can import prior history.

Story 5's active-branch import logic is implemented in the core service, and Story 7's `lh-fixture pi-session` command uses that live branch context successfully, but `/lh-attach` does not pass the same context, so the operator-facing import path diverges from the working service path.

Store/service-level stories are broadly implemented and unit-tested, but the extension-command seam is undercovered, which let cross-story regressions in attach/import ship while lower-level tests stayed green.
architectureFindings: PI Runtime Integration drifts from the tech design contract that active-path import should use the current leaf/session branch when available; `/lh-attach` falls back to raw file ambiguity detection instead.

Verification architecture drifts from the test plan: `verify-all` passes even though the planned `*.integration.test.ts` suite is absent, so the epic gate does not deliver the reopen/import/concurrency/temp-file smoke coverage it claims to provide.

The import path still relies on a synthesized `sessionManager` shim in `import-service.ts` rather than a first-class import mapping contract, which is a non-real execution path inside production code.
epicCoverageAssessment: `npm run verify` passed with 104 unit tests across capture, store, turn, import, repair, fixture, and command-format behaviors.
`npm run verify-all` also exited 0, but the integration phase printed `No integration tests found.`, so the epic gate is green without the planned integration suite.
Core import behavior is present and works through `attachExistingPiSession(...)`, but the registered `/lh-attach` command path is not production-ready.
`tests/context-steward/pi-extension-commands.test.ts` only exercises `lh-fixture` and `lh-status`; the planned `/lh-attach`, `/lh-turn-health`, and `/lh-repair-turns` command coverage is missing.
productionPathFindings: Production live capture preempts attach/import: once the extension handles `session_start`, `/lh-attach` rejects the same session as already managed instead of importing prior history.
Production `/lh-attach` ignores live `SessionManager` branch context and fails branched-session imports with `IMPORT_PATH_AMBIGUOUS` even when the current leaf is available in the running session.

`src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts` constructs a synthetic `sessionManager` object with dummy `getBranch/getEntries/getLeafId` behavior for message mapping; this is a real shim in the production import path.
`verify-all` is effectively a placeholder integration gate today because `scripts/run-node-tests.mjs` exits success when no `*.integration.test.ts` files exist.

blockingFindings.title: `/lh-attach` drops current-branch context and breaks branched-session import
blockingFindings.evidence: `executeAttachCommand(...)` passes only `store`, `target`, and `sessionFilePath` into `attachExistingPiSession(...)`; unlike `executeFixtureCommand(...)`, it does not pass `activeLeafIdFromContext(...)` or `importSessionManagerFromContext(...)`. The service supports those inputs, but the command never supplies them. In direct repro with a branched session whose live context exposed `getLeafId()` and `getBranch()`, `lh-attach` still failed with `IMPORT_PATH_AMBIGUOUS ... expected exactly one leaf candidate but found 2` instead of importing the active branch.

blockingFindings.title: Automatic session bootstrap makes `/lh-attach` unusable for already-open PI sessions
blockingFindings.evidence: `registerContextStewardExtension` routes `session_start` through `captureEvent(...)`, which calls `ensureActiveThread(...)` and `openOrCreateManagedThread(...)` before any command runs. `executeAttachCommand(...)` then delegates to `attachExistingPiSession(...)`, and that service immediately fails if the target is already managed. In direct repro, emitting `session_start` and then invoking `lh-attach` returned `Attach failed: PI target session-preempt is already managed by thread ... [TARGET_ASSOCIATION_CONFLICT]`, so prior session history cannot be imported into the live managed thread.

nonBlockingFindings.title: Planned extension-command coverage is incomplete
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: `tests/context-steward/pi-extension-commands.test.ts` only covers `lh-fixture` and `lh-status`. The test plan's command section expects explicit operator-path coverage for `/lh-attach`, `/lh-turn-health`, `/lh-repair-turns`, `/lh-fixture`, and `/lh-status`. That gap explains why the broken `/lh-attach` production seam was not caught by the current suite.

nonBlockingFindings.title: Import mapping depends on a synthetic `sessionManager` shim
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: `importRuntimeContext(...)` in `src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts` builds a fabricated `ctx.sessionManager` with dummy `getLeafEntry/getEntry/getLabel/getBranch/getEntries/getTree/getSessionName` implementations just to satisfy `mapPiMessageEnd(...)`. Current behavior passes because the mapper only reads session id/file data, but the production import path is still coupled to a non-real adapter that can silently drift from PI's real runtime contract.

nonBlockingFindings.title: `verify-all` passes without running the planned integration coverage
nonBlockingFindings.evidence: The test plan calls for `file-thread-store.integration.test.ts` coverage for process-style reopen, file-path import, overlapping capture serialization, and stale temp-file recovery. The repo currently has no `*.integration.test.ts` files under `tests/`, and `scripts/run-node-tests.mjs` exits 0 with `No integration tests found.` when the integration file set is empty. Observed `npm run verify-all` output ended exactly that way.

unresolvedItems: Decide whether attach/import should suppress automatic thread creation until history import runs, or whether `/lh-attach` should be able to hydrate an already-created empty managed thread without violating source-order/import-range guarantees.
Decide whether `test:integration` should fail closed when no integration tests exist, or whether a different epic-smoke mechanism will replace the missing `*.integration.test.ts` suite.
Current worktree still shows `.pi/extensions/context-steward.ts` as untracked; confirm the PI entrypoint is intended to ship as part of the epic deliverable.
